name: Securities Order Parameters
definition: Parameters of the transfer of a financial instrument.

AutoRouting.name: Auto Routing
AutoRouting.definition: Indicates whether an automatic routing system is involved.

CorporateActionOptionIndicator.name: Corporate Action Option Indicator
CorporateActionOptionIndicator.definition: Indicates the possible options or choices available to account owner (for investment funds).

ExecutionTimeLimit.name: Execution Time Limit
ExecutionTimeLimit.definition: Indicates from/until when an order must be executed.

PreAllocationConditionIndicator.name: Pre Allocation Condition Indicator
PreAllocationConditionIndicator.definition: Indicates the conditions that apply to a pre-allocation.

PriorityIndicator.name: Priority Indicator
PriorityIndicator.definition: Indicates the execution priority of the trade.

RequestedDealCurrency.name: Requested Deal Currency
RequestedDealCurrency.definition: Currency in which a trade should be executed.

OrderHandlingInstruction.name: Order Handling Instruction
OrderHandlingInstruction.definition: Specifies instructions for order handling on the broker trading floor.

StockLocateRequired.name: Stock Locate Required
StockLocateRequired.definition: Indicates whether the broker is to locate the stock in conjunction with a short sell order.|This information is mandatory in case of short sales. When executed, the report will then mention the securities location.

WorkingIndicator.name: Working Indicator
WorkingIndicator.definition: Indicates if the order is currently being worked. For open outcry markets this indicates that the order is being worked in the crowd.  For electronic markets it indicates that the order has transitioned from a contingent order to a market order.

BookPriorityIndicator.name: Book Priority Indicator
BookPriorityIndicator.definition: Indicates if a Cancel/Replace has caused an order to lose book priority.

MaxPriceLevels.name: Max Price Levels
MaxPriceLevels.definition: Allows an order to specify a maximum number of price levels to trade through.

PreTradeAnonymity.name: Pre Trade Anonymity
PreTradeAnonymity.definition: Allows trader to explicitly request anonymity or disclosure in pre-trade market data feeds. Anonymity is relevant in markets where counterparties are regularly disclosed in order depth feeds. Disclosure is relevant when counterparties are not normally visible.

GoodTillBooking.name: Good Till Booking
GoodTillBooking.definition: For partially good till orders, the specification of whether to book each execution, or to accumulate the executions.

ManualOrderIndicator.name: Manual Order Indicator
ManualOrderIndicator.definition: Indicates if the order was initially received manually (as opposed to electronically).

DirectedOrder.name: Directed Order
DirectedOrder.definition: Indicates if the customer directed this order to a specific execution venue (Y) or not (N).

ReceivedDepartment.name: Received Department
ReceivedDepartment.definition: Identifies the Broker / Dealer Department that first took the order.

CustomerHandlingInstruction.name: Customer Handling Instruction
CustomerHandlingInstruction.definition: Codes that apply special information that the Broker / Dealer needs to report, as specified by the customer.

ProcessCode.name: Process Code
ProcessCode.definition: Used to identify soft trades at order entry.

MinimumQuantity.name: Minimum Quantity
MinimumQuantity.definition: Minimum quantity of financial instrument to be bought or sold if the entire order cannot be executed.

MatchIncrement.name: Match Increment
MatchIncrement.definition: Allows orders to specify a minimum quantity that applies to every execution. (one execution could be for multiple counter-orders). The order may still fill against smaller orders, but the cumulative quantity of the execution must be in multiples of the MatchIncrement.

PegInstructions.name: Peg Instructions
PegInstructions.definition: Additional instructions if the order is pegged.

RelatedSecuritiesOrder.name: Related Securities Order
RelatedSecuritiesOrder.definition: Securities order for which parameters are specified.
